name: Grit: sampler machine
description: 7th machine "Grit": plays samples from the +Drive, chosen in the browser like on the Model:Samples.
COLOR = sample start, SHAPE = sample length (the waveform shows while you turn, with start and end lines),
FUNC + COLOR = move start and end together, CONTOUR = model: CLEAN, SP (26 kHz fixed clock, drop-sample, 12 bit,
4-pole 12 kHz), LM (28 kHz clock with pitch, 8-bit mu-law, 2-pole 11 kHz), MIRAGE (29.4 kHz with pitch, 8 bit,
2-pole 8 kHz with a little resonance), TX16W (33.3 kHz fixed clock, drop-sample, 12-bit floating point,
2-pole 12.5 kHz), MPC60 (40 kHz with pitch, 12-bit floating point, 2-pole 15 kHz); PUNCH = loop, GATE = reverse.
Sample locks lock only the sample; the samples of the playing pattern are preloaded (up to 32).
Device Config > Transfer: CYC / SMP (answers Elektron Transfer as a Model:Samples, for uploading samples;
method from Model-TG by TinyGregAudio, MIT; own code). Every boot starts at CYC.
Grit, Vlvt and Monom only work together: Vlvt needs Grit, Monom needs Grit and Vlvt.
device: Model:Cycles OS 1.13 (also a Model:Samples running it)
